result.title: From Data to Wisdom: Rethinking AI Through an Epistemic Lens
result.summary: This paper proposes the Data-to-Wisdom Epistemic Architecture for AI (EAAI), a conceptual framework treating Data, Information, Knowledge, Understanding and Wisdom as five distinct but recursively interacting epistemic functions: observation, contextual interpretation, modeling and prediction, critical evaluation and informed judgment. Two observations motivate it: sequential readings of the Knowledge Pyramid obscure how these functions interact, and a targeted review of ten Bayesian reference books finds that prior distributions are defined mathematically while "prior information" and "prior knowledge" are not consistently distinguished as epistemic categories. A Bayesian interpretation relates the likelihood, prior and posterior distributions, posterior prediction, model checking and decision analysis to the five functions, without limiting EAAI to Bayesian systems. Extending "prior" in an epistemic sense, the paper distinguishes five kinds of prior context that can shape the model, the likelihood, the prior, evaluation and action. Three worked applications -- quantitative financial risk, actuarial modeling in health insurance and agentic AI for medical reimbursement claims -- show how EAAI structures the analysis of model assumptions, evidence interpretation, validation, dependencies and decision consequences, separating the prediction of a risk, the appraisal of its reliability and the justification of action. It draws implications for AI and machine learning, including evaluation by function, treating intermediate model outputs as evidence open to challenge and separating generation from appraisal, and compares EAAI with work on DIKW, Bayesian workflow, AI evaluation and risk governance. Its contributions are an epistemic vocabulary with recursive relationships, a more accessible reading of Bayesian methodology, a typology of prior context and clearer methodological terminology.

AI.brief_summary: 这是一篇概念性框架论文，提出把 Data、Information、Knowledge、Understanding、Wisdom 视为五种递归互动的认知功能的 EAAI 架构，并用贝叶斯要素（似然、先验、后验预测、模型检验、决策分析）作类比阐释，再以金融风险、健康保险精算和医疗报销 agent 三个应用展示该框架如何组织假设、证据解释、验证与决策后果的分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「观测—情境解释—建模预测—批判评估—判断」的功能划分以及「生成与评估分离」「把中间模型输出当作可质疑的证据」等主张，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否被真正使用、视觉证据筛选与停止判断的评价提供概念词汇；但属纯概念讨论，与多模态或 latent 生成无直接实验联系，迁移价值需自行核查。
